1.title: CVE-2026-129258 (CVSS 9.1)
1.summary: A vulnerability was identified in Tenda AC18 15.03.05.05_multi/15.03.05.19 Build 6318. Affected by this vulnerability is an unknown functionality of the file /cgi-bin/upgrade of the component Firmware Upgrade Handler. Such manipulation of the argument upgradeFile leads to insufficient verification of data authenticity. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used.

1.title: CVE-2026-129351 (CVSS 10.0)
1.summary: A security vulnerability has been detected in TRENDnet TEW-657BRM 1.00.1. This vulnerability affects the function sprintf of the file /setup.cgi of the component mini_httpd. Such manipulation leads to out-of-bounds write. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used. The vendor explains: ""I am not able to confirm if such vulnerability exists as the product has been EOL for more than 15 years. We will send out an announcement letting customers know." This vulnerability only affects products that are no longer supported by the maintainer.

1.title: CVE-2026-129352 (CVSS 9.1)
1.summary: A vulnerability was detected in TRENDnet TEW-657BRM 1.00.1. This issue affects some unknown processing of the file /usr/sbin/upgrade_flash.cgi. Performing a manipulation of the argument boundary results in stack-based buffer overflow. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used. The vendor explains: ""I am not able to confirm if such vulnerability exists as the product has been EOL for more than 15 years. We will send out an announcement letting customers know."

1.title: CVE-2026-129353 (CVSS 10.0)
1.summary: A vulnerability was detected in D-Link DIR-600L 2.17/2.17b02. Affected by this vulnerability is the function authenticationcgi_main of the file authentication.cgi. Performing a manipulation of the argument id/password results in stack-based buffer overflow. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit is now public and may be used.

1.title: CVE-2026-129354 (CVSS 10.0)
1.summary: A flaw has been found in D-Link DIR-600L 2.17b02. Affected by this issue is the function hnap_main of the file htdocs/cgibin of the component HNAP Handler. Executing a manipulation can lead to stack-based buffer overflow. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used.

1.title: CVE-2026-129444 (CVSS 10.0)
1.summary: A vulnerability was identified in D-Link DSL-6740C 20131126. This affects an unknown function of the file /etc/templates/ftpd/ftpd_conf.php of the component FTP Daemon. Such manipulation leads to hard-coded credentials. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used.

1.title: CVE-2026-129449 (CVSS 9.9)
1.summary: A security vulnerability has been detected in DrayTek Vigor2960 up to 1.5.1.6. Affected by this vulnerability is the function sub_14914 of the file /cgi-bin/mainfunction.cgi. The manipulation of the argument swmconfigupload leads to command injection. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used. Upgrading to version 1.5.1.7 addresses this issue. It is advisable to upgrade the affected component. The vendor recommends: "1.5.1.6 isn't the latest version of 2960, the latest version fixes many security issues. And we have another one in our release plan which should solve the issues reported."

1.title: CVE-2026-129450 (CVSS 9.9)
1.summary: A vulnerability was detected in DrayTek Vigor2960 1.5.1.6. Affected by this issue is the function sub_1E084 of the file /cgi-bin/mainfunction.cgi?action=doWebBackup. The manipulation of the argument option results in path traversal. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used. Upgrading to version 1.5.1.7 can resolve this issue. You should upgrade the affected component. The vendor recommends: "1.5.1.6 isn't the latest version of 2960, the latest version fixes many security issues. And we have another one in our release plan which should solve the issues reported."

1.title: CVE-2026-129451 (CVSS 9.9)
1.summary: A flaw has been found in DrayTek Vigor2960 up to 1.5.1.6. This affects the function app_guest_export of the file /cgi-bin/mainfunction.cgi. This manipulation of the argument filename causes path traversal. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used. Upgrading to version 1.5.1.7 is able to mitigate this issue. The affected component should be upgraded. The vendor recommends: "1.5.1.6 isn't the latest version of 2960, the latest version fixes many security issues. And we have another one in our release plan which should solve the issues reported."

1.title: CVE-2026-129452 (CVSS 9.1)
1.summary: A vulnerability has been found in DrayTek Vigor2960 1.5.1.6. This vulnerability affects the function set_table of the file /cgi-bin/mainfunction.cgi. Such manipulation of the argument jsondata leads to command injection. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. Upgrading to version 1.5.1.7 is able to resolve this issue. It is suggested to upgrade the affected component. The vendor recommends: "1.5.1.6 isn't the latest version of 2960, the latest version fixes many security issues. And we have another one in our release plan which should solve the issues reported."
